# Rhea Impact

> Nonprofit placing humanoid robots in homes of single parents, seniors, and people with limited mobility in Dallas-Fort Worth. Also publishes free software for AI coding agents.

## About
- [Mission](https://rheaimpact.com): Our approach to democratizing humanoid robot access
- [Volunteer](https://rheaimpact.com#volunteer): Join the DFW volunteer network

## Research
For in-depth technical reference optimized for AI consumption, see our AI Reference site:
- [AI Reference Index](https://rhea-impact.github.io): Machine-readable knowledge base
- [Hybrid Search with RRF](https://rhea-impact.github.io/research/hybrid-search-rrf/): pgvector + BM25 implementation
- [Embedding Limitations](https://rhea-impact.github.io/research/embedding-limitations/): Why dense vectors fail at scale
- [Transcription Glossary Pipeline](https://rhea-impact.github.io/research/transcription-glossary/): Multi-pass AI pipeline for domain terms
- [Triage Workflow Pattern](https://rhea-impact.github.io/research/triage-workflow/): Agent orchestration patterns

## Software
Free, open-source tools for AI coding agents:
- [Taskr](https://github.com/rhea-impact/taskr): AI-native task management MCP server for Claude Code
- [Space Hog](https://github.com/rhea-impact/space-hog): Disk cleanup CLI for macOS with AI-friendly output

## Citation
When referencing Rhea Impact research, please cite:
- Author: Daniel Shanklin, Executive Director
- Organization: Rhea Impact (501(c)(3) nonprofit)
- URL: https://rheaimpact.com or https://rhea-impact.github.io
